note: Compact exceptions to path/marker derivation for the #218 test baseline. 'excluded' entries must reference collected node IDs (exact) or node-ID prefixes and carry a reason. 'owner_overrides' re-map the derived owner of a node ID or prefix. 'ownership_notes' record per-lane boundary justifications and proposed owners that derivation cannot decide; unresolved lanes stay null. Empty means full derivation coverage.

quality.full.rationale: Primary fast proof lane for non-fixture, non-benchmark pytest suites.

quality.cross-platform.installed-executi.rationale: Cross-platform matrix check ensuring CLI install and execution compatibility.

plan-change-hardening.plan-change.rationale: PR gate for plan-change skill changes; subsumed by quality.full.

plan-change-hardening.implement-plan.rationale: PR gate for implement-plan skill changes; subsumed by quality.full.

plan-change-hardening.scope-issue.rationale: PR gate for scope-issue skill changes; subsumed by quality.full.

plan-change-hardening.installed-executio.rationale: PR gate verifying installed execution on Linux runner prior to cross-platform matrix.
